problem_statement: RIOT's PSA Crypto API must support ChaCha20 as a stream cipher. A 32-byte key of type PSA_KEY_TYPE_CHACHA20 with algorithm PSA_ALG_STREAM_CIPHER and 256 key bits must be importable, and psa_cipher_encrypt() followed by psa_cipher_decrypt() must round-trip plaintext. Encryption must place a 12-byte nonce at the start of the output buffer before the ciphertext and set the output length accordingly; decryption must accept that nonce-prefixed buffer and recover the original plaintext.

verification.reason: The problem statement describes the behaviour well (key type, algorithm, 256 bits, 12-byte nonce, round-trip) but omits the name of the RIOT build module / pseudomodule that the test Makefile enables (psa_cipher_chacha20). Adding that name to the statement is a fair public-interface addition.

problems.detail: The test Makefile uses USEMODULE += psa_cipher_chacha20, but the problem statement never mentions this build module / pseudomodule name. The agent cannot know the exact module name to create without seeing the fix or the test.

problem_statement_fixed: RIOT's PSA Crypto API must support ChaCha20 as a stream cipher. A new build module psa_cipher_chacha20 must be added so that the PSA cipher infrastructure can dispatch ChaCha20 operations. A 32-byte key of type PSA_KEY_TYPE_CHACHA20 with algorithm PSA_ALG_STREAM_CIPHER and 256 key bits must be importable, and psa_cipher_encrypt() followed by psa_cipher_decrypt() must round-trip plaintext. Encryption must place a 12-byte nonce at the start of the output buffer before the ciphertext and set the output length accordingly; decryption must accept that nonce-prefixed buffer and recover the original plaintext.
